title: Continued-Use Date on a PAP Supply Replenishment Program Enrollment
content:
**Rule.** Each enrollment in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program carries a continued-use date: the date of the latest proof of continued use of the patient's PAP device. When the proof of continued use that governs on the device record is credited with a date newer than the continued-use date on the supply enrollment, the enrollment's continued-use date is brought up to that credited date; a date that is not newer leaves the enrollment as it is.

A patient's own account of use is never proof, and a date is recorded only from the device record.

## Business effect

| Credited date of the governing proof, compared with the enrollment's continued-use date | Result on the enrollment |
|---|---|
| newer | the continued-use date becomes the credited date |
| the same or older | the continued-use date stays as it is |

The change touches only the continued-use date: the supply order date and every other enrollment detail stay as they are.

## Recording the date — `record_continued_use_proof_c97fce72`

**Capability.** `record_continued_use_proof_c97fce72` records a newer proof of continued PAP device use on the patient's supply enrollment. One call replaces the enrollment's continued-use date with the date credited to the proof taken from the device's compliance data or the treating practitioner's note; the supply order date and every other enrollment detail stay as they are. The new date is visible on the enrollment at once.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `record_continued_use_proof_c97fce72` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `resupply_holding_id` | the reference number of the patient's PAP supply enrollment, read from the enrollment lookup before the call | identifier text |
| `last_continued_use_date` | the date credited to the proof of continued use | YYYY-MM-DD |

**Return.** A receipt in which `status` is `proof_recorded` when the enrollment was updated; `resupply_holding_id` echoes the enrollment; `last_continued_use_date` is the continued-use date now on the enrollment (YYYY-MM-DD); `previous_continued_use_date` is the date it replaced (YYYY-MM-DD).

## Basis Q&A

**The patient reports nightly use but the device record holds no newer proof. Is the continued-use date changed?** No. A patient's own account of use is never proof; a date is recorded only from the device record.

**The governing proof on the device record is credited with the same date the enrollment already shows. Is anything recorded?** No. A date that is not newer leaves the enrollment as it is.
